chars.name: Consort Knife
props: Acrobatics +6, Sleight of Hand +6, Stealth +8, Performance +3
tonight: The target's player rolls d20 + (AC − 10). Meet or beat 18 and the attack misses.
The Knives strike last each round.
When its mark dies, at 26 hit points, or at the end of round 5.
Grapple: Athletics or Acrobatics DC 16. Snatch its tablet (action): Sleight of Hand DC 16.

items: It has one mark. It ignores everyone else unless they grapple it, block its path, or stand over its fallen mark.

A creature dropped to 0 hit points by this poison is Kissed: unconscious, and it automatically fails one death save at the start of each turn. Healing wakes it, but it takes 7 poison damage at the start of each turn until cured (lesser restoration, protection from poison, or antitoxin with a DC 15 Medicine check).
It knows its mark, its signal and its exit point. Checks to make it talk have disadvantage (Intimidation DC 16).
Melee, reach 5 ft. Defense DC 18. Hit: 13 (6 piercing + 7 poison). Against its mark: one defense roll a round, and a failure moves the champion one step along the track.
Teleports up to 30 feet to a space it can see. Needs a free hand. Not while grappled or restrained, or once the tablet is taken.
Dimension door to its fixed exit. Same limits as the Step Tablet.
Halves the damage of one attack that hits it, if it can see the attacker.

chars.name: Consort Marksman
chars.ac: 14 (leather under livery); 16 from the floor (half cover at the rail)
tonight: The target's player rolls d20 + (AC − 10). +2 if the target is inside the crowd.
Each shoots the most exposed PC: standing over a fallen mark, grappling a Knife, on the stair, flying, or outside the crowd.
At 16 hit points, or at the end of round 6.
Musicians' loggia above and behind the dais. A small stair at each end, or climb with Athletics DC 13.

items: Ranged, 80/320 ft. Defense DC 17. Hit: 6 piercing, and the target makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is poisoned until the end of its next turn. A target that fails while already poisoned this way falls unconscious until the end of its next turn, or until it takes damage or is shaken awake.
Dimension door to its fixed exit. Needs a free hand. Not while grappled or restrained, or once the tablet is taken.
When a creature it can see within 80 feet grapples a Knife, stands over a Knife's fallen mark, or starts climbing toward the loggia, it makes one light crossbow attack against it.

chars.name: The Hand
tonight: Six stand. It breaks one at the end of each round; the last goes at the end of round 6, and Cassian is Kissed.
It stops breaking wards and fights them. The ward clock stops.
At 45 hit points, or once Cassian is dead.

items: While any ward stands, the Hand cannot come within 10 feet of the bed or target Cassian. Each ward that breaks rings like a bell through the manor. A creature beside a rune can use its action to restore one ward (maximum six) with a DC 14 Arcana check, or DC 10 with a blank rune tablet.
Its mark is Lord Cassian. It fights anyone who gets between them.

A creature dropped to 0 hit points by this poison is Kissed: unconscious, and it automatically fails one death save at the start of each turn. Healing wakes it, but it takes 7 poison damage at the start of each turn until cured (lesser restoration, protection from poison, or antitoxin with a DC 15 Medicine check).
Melee, reach 5 ft. Defense DC 19. Hit: 14 (7 piercing + 7 poison).
It drives a counter-rune spike into a ward. One ward breaks. Tonight this happens automatically at the end of each round while it is alone.
Teleports up to 30 feet to a space it can see. Needs a free hand. Not while grappled or restrained, or once the tablet is taken.
Dimension door to its fixed exit. Same limits as the Step Tablet.
Halves the damage of one attack that hits it, if it can see the attacker.

chars.name: Éclair Exquisite
tonight: Her player rolls d20 + 5 against the Knife's DC 18.
Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead. A failed defense moves one step right. A natural 20 counters and knocks the Knife prone.
Each time she defends successfully, her Knife takes 9.
Round 0: DC 16 Constitution save (+3). Pass: Bleeding. Fail: Kissed.

items: Difficult terrain costs her no extra movement, so the crowd does not slow her.
Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.
One rapier attack with advantage. On a hit, +14 piercing and DC 16 Constitution save or stunned until the end of her next turn.

chars.name: Garrick Moravel
tonight: Their player rolls d20 + 3 against the Knife's DC 18.
Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead. A failed defense moves one step right. A natural 20 counters and knocks the Knife prone.
His player rolls a d6 at the top of each round. On a 5 or 6, one Knife takes 15.
After a failed defense roll, add +5 to it.
Round 0: DC 16 Constitution save (+5). Pass: Bleeding. Fail: Kissed.

items: Ranged spell attack +6, 120 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) force.

chars.name: Noémie Vayne
tonight: Their player rolls d20 + 3 against the Knife's DC 18.
Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead. A failed defense moves one step right. A natural 20 counters and knocks the Knife prone.

Her player rolls a d6 at the top of each round. On a 5 or 6, every champion within 20 feet is cured and wakes (Steady), and each Knife within 20 feet takes 18 radiant. The court sees green-gold light.
After a failed defense roll, add +5 to it.
Round 0: DC 16 Constitution save (+5). Pass: Bleeding. Fail: Kissed.

items: Ranged spell attack +6, 120 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) force.

tonight: Their player rolls d20 + 3 against the Knife's DC 18.
Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead. A failed defense moves one step right. A natural 20 counters and knocks the Knife prone.
After a failed defense roll, add +5 to it.
Round 0: DC 16 Constitution save (+5). Pass: Bleeding. Fail: Kissed.

items: Ranged spell attack +6, 120 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) force.

chars.name: Rowan Halvenne
tonight: Their player rolls d20 + 3 against the Knife's DC 18.
Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead. A failed defense moves one step right. A natural 20 counters and knocks the Knife prone.
Once a PC hands him a blade: each successful defense deals his Knife 9.
After a failed defense roll, add +5 to it.
Round 0: DC 16 Constitution save (+5). Pass: Bleeding. Fail: Kissed.
His table is the one nearest the party.

items: Ranged spell attack +6, 120 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) force.

chars.name: Lord Cassian Aerrowyn
tonight: Safe while any of the six wards stands.
End of round 6: Kissed. End of round 7: dead unless a PC is in the room.
PC attacks against the Hand have advantage, and he deals the Hand 14 fire each round. No roll.

items: At half hit points or fewer he ignores the frightened condition.
When he takes damage from an attack he can see, he reduces it by 5.

chars.name: Lt. Malachai Wrent
chars.sub: Medium humanoid (human), lawful good · Marshal Lieutenant
tonight: Gus's player rolls d20 + 4 against the Knife's DC 18.
Hit in the marksmen's opening volley.
Top of round 1 he dives over a Kissed champion, two crowd boxes from Gus. The Knife must go through him. He uses the champion track.
Gus can wake him and stand over him. Only Gabriele or Timbit can cure him.
Hand Shane the Annex C handout.

items: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Melee +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (6 bludgeoning + 7 force).
One creature within 60 feet: DC 15 Wisdom save or restrained by bands of light for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn.

chars.name: Marshal Constable-Adept
tonight: The Marshals inside the hall were dropped by the marksmen before initiative.
Reinforcements reach the floor through the garden doors, against the crowd. By then the Knives are gone.

items: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
One creature within 30 feet: DC 12 Dexterity save or restrained for 1 minute. DC 12 Strength check as an action to break free.

chars.name: Marquis Corvane Aerrowyn
chars.ac: 18 (half plate, shield); your call what he wears at his own gala
props: Athletics +8, Deception +7, Insight +6, Intimidation +10, Perception +6, Persuasion +7
tonight: The shield-rune dome traps him with the Queen, two guards, the herald and the page for 10 rounds. Nothing passes in or out.
The dome falls and he runs for the stairs.

items: Advantage on initiative and on saves against being frightened. Cannot be surprised while conscious.
Nothing Left to Lose but One Thing
While his heir is incapacitated or in danger and within his sight, he attacks with advantage and has resistance to all damage.
Melee +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning, and DC 16 Strength save or pushed 5 feet with disadvantage on its next attack.
One creature within 60 feet: DC 15 Wisdom save or frightened of him for 1 minute.
When hit by a melee attack, he makes one warhammer attack against the attacker.
When an ally within 10 feet would take damage, he takes it instead.

chars.name: Belaskro
tonight: Rolls d20 + 5 against DC 18 (Knife), 17 (marksman) or 19 (the Hand).
Cure Wounds. He cannot cure the poison.
Three blank tablets: shore up a ward at DC 10 instead of 14 (his Arcana is +0).
Snatch a Knife's tablet from 10 feet: Sleight of Hand +4 against DC 16.

chars.name: Gabriele
tonight: Rolls d20 + 5 against DC 18 (Knife), 17 (marksman) or 19 (the Hand).
Healing Word (60 ft, bonus action), Cure Wounds, a healing potion.
Channel Divinity: wakes every Kissed champion within 30 feet.

chars.name: Gus
tonight: Rolls d20 + 8 against DC 18 (Knife), 17 (marksman) or 19 (the Hand).
Cure Wounds. He cannot cure the poison.
Can stand over a champion as Protect.

chars.name: Princess Timbit
tonight: Rolls d20 + 1 against DC 18 (Knife), 17 (marksman) or 19 (the Hand).
Lesser Restoration (bonus action), Protection from Poison.
Spare the Dying (15 ft): a Kissed champion loses no pip this round.
She needs a 17 to avoid a Knife.
